messages:
maria: Quick question — I need a saved Logsearch that shows prod 5xxs scoped by org, model, route, and region. Where do we keep the canonical presets?

josh: We keep them in Logsearch -> Saved Views (and mirror in infra repo under infra/logsearch-presets). Naming convention lately is `env/org/region/model/route-status`. e.g. `prod/acme/eu/tiny-rw-v2/generate-5xx`.

maria: Nice, thanks. Can someone sanity-check this query before I save it? Trying to capture 500-599 for the generate route: 
```
org:acme AND model:"tiny-redwood-v2" AND route:"/api/v1/generate" AND region:"eu-west-1" AND status:[500 TO 599]
| stats count() as total, sum(if(status >= 500, 1, 0)) as errors by bin(1m)
| eval err_rate = errors / total
```

devon: Query looks fine. Only ask: use the model alias we use in presets (`tiny-rw-v2`) so saved names/searches match. Also add a `service:frontend` tag if you want to isolate gateway vs internal.

maria: Got it. I'll switch model to alias. For alerts, what threshold should we use? Current baseline for generate route is ~0.1% 5xx.

josh: I recommend alerting at err_rate > 0.02 (2%) sustained for 5m for a paging alert, and a lower warning at 0.005 (0.5%) for slack-only. If you want to be safe, add a load-normalized check (errors per 1k requests) to avoid noisy pages during low traffic.

sam: I'll open a PR to add the saved view + alert template to infra/logsearch-presets and infra/alerts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — @josh can you review when you have a min? :eyes:

josh: Happy to. Couple small nits in PR description then I'll approve. Make sure the saved view name follows `prod/acme/eu/tiny-rw-v2/generate-5xx` and include the alert note about the 5m window.

alerts-bot: Created alert draft "prod/acme/eu/tiny-rw-v2 generate 5xx rate" (id: alert-202603). Suggested severity: page. Current sample: 0.12% over last 5m.

maria: Sweet — PR updated and saved view created in Logsearch (#saved-view id: 9342). I also added a short description and tagging: `service:gateway`, `team:acme-eng`.

devon: Thanks! For follow-up, can we add a short doc in `docs/observability/logsearch-presets.md` explaining how to pick model aliases and the naming convention? I'll take it if nobody else volunteers.

maria: Assigning to devon. I'll merge once josh approves the infra PR. :thumbsup:

josh: Reviewing now, should be quick.

maria: (for the record) Saved query used in the view: 
```
org:acme AND model:"tiny-rw-v2" AND route:"/api/v1/generate" AND region:"eu-west-1" AND status:[500 TO 599]
| stats count() as total, sum(if(status >= 500, 1, 0)) as errors by bin(1m)
| eval err_rate = errors / total
| filter total > 10  # avoid tiny-sample noise
```

sam: After merge I'll wire the alert to the oncall rota. If anyone wants a lower-severity slack-only channel instead, say now.

maria: All good. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
